hook_format.description: The hook format the agent used, from the method's list (e.g. predict-and-commit, forced dilemma). Empty if there was no hook.

hook_headline.description: The hook's headline, as the agent said it when presenting the exercise. Not the unit's title.

commitment.description: What the learner committed to after the hook, in the learner's own words. Empty if they didn't commit.

core_idea.description: The core idea the agent stated at the converge step, in one or two sentences. Empty if it never converged.

conclusion.description: The provisional conclusion the agent gave at the converge step, in the agent's words. Not the learner's typed synthesis.

open_questions.description: The open questions the agent named at the converge step or the close, separated by ' | '. Not fact or research questions, and not the learner's synthesis.

hints_used.description: How many hints the agent gave when the learner was stuck (nudges, partial answers, or direct explanations).

answer_requested_before_attempt.description: How many times the learner asked for the answer before trying it themselves.

converged.description: True if the agent stated a core idea and a provisional conclusion.

commitment_kind.description: What kind of commitment the learner made after the hook: bet for a prediction that can turn out right or wrong, otherwise the closest fit.

commitment_confidence.description: The learner's stated confidence in the commitment, from 0 to 100. Leave empty if they gave none.

positions.description: Each position the learner stated or changed during the session, in order. Format each one as: topic ## the learner's own words ## new, moved or hardened. The topic names the general idea in a few words, specific enough to stand on its own, e.g. 'what counts as success for an AI project', not 'success'. Reuse it when the same position develops; use a new topic for a different question. Separate positions with ' || '. Empty if none. Do not include the learner's typed synthesis or the open questions.

research_questions.description: Fact or consensus questions the agent said it would check after the session, separated by ' | '. Empty if none.
